claims.claim: Net sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $47.9 billion.
Second quarter fiscal 2026 net sales increased 5.7% from the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
Net earnings for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $4.8 billion, or $4.79 per diluted share.
Net earnings in the second quarter of fiscal 2025 were $4.6 billion, or $4.58 per diluted share.
Adjusted (non-GAAP) diluted earnings per share for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 were $4.92, compared with $4.68 in the same period of fiscal 2025.
Comparable sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 increased 1.7%.
U.S. comparable sales for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 increased 1.3%.
Net sales for the six months ended August 2, 2026 were $89.6 billion, an increase of 5.3% from the prior year period.
The company attributes results to investments across the business and associates' focus on customer service, and noted customers continued to engage in smaller projects.
Comparable customer transactions decreased 1.0% in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.
Comparable average ticket increased 2.8% in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.
Customer transactions and average ticket measures do not include results from HD Supply or SRS.
At the end of the second quarter the company operated 2,364 retail stores and over 1,340 SRS locations.
The company reaffirms its fiscal 2026 guidance, which includes IEEPA tariff refunds expected to partially offset unplanned fuel, energy, and other product input costs.
Fiscal 2026 guidance projects total sales growth of approximately 2.5% to 4.5% and comparable sales growth of approximately flat to 2.0%.
Diluted earnings per share is guided to grow approximately flat to 4.0% from $14.23 in fiscal 2025.
Adjusted (non-GAAP) diluted earnings per share is guided to grow approximately flat to 4.0% from $14.69 in fiscal 2025.
Cash and cash equivalents were $2.1 billion at the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2026, compared with $2.8 billion at the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
Net cash provided by operating activities for the six months ended August 2, 2026 was $11.4 billion, compared with $9.0 billion in the prior year period.
Capital expenditures for the six months ended August 2, 2026 were $1.7 billion, consistent with the prior year period.
SRS Distribution, Inc. contributed $125 million to acquired intangible asset amortization in the second quarter of fiscal 2026.
